decision: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING — All three materially orthogonal null frameworks fail to center PMI null at zero for the 12-state hash-routed SPA simulation. Parametric bootstrap null mean 0.357 bits (3.57x above |0.1| threshold, 14.5% improvement over within-stratum 0.417). Miller-Madow null mean 0.407 bits (4.07x above, +13.6% signal boost but null unchanged). Conditional entropy null mean -0.814 bits degenerate (positive control fails: H_full=0.0 on deterministic SPA by construction). Within-stratum permutation 0.417 replicates parent exactly. The null control problem is intrinsic to PMI estimator weighting across deterministic/stochastic strata (31.5% deterministic with PMI=0 diluting weighted average), not permutation scheme or estimator choice. 0/3 frameworks pass frozen decision rule. Measurement valid (audit PASS). The 0.933-bit K2 PMI signal remains reproducible (p=0.001, d~79) but cannot support confirmatory beyond-Markov claim without valid null control.

claim_updates.reason: No change to claim status from prior HYPOTHESIS. This experiment falsifies three specific null centering methodologies (parametric bootstrap, Miller-Madow, conditional entropy) for the 12-state hash-routed SPA at N=5000, but does not accumulate evidence for or against the core claim that real Web transitions contain predictive dynamical structure beyond memory. The 0.933-bit K2 PMI signal is real and reproducible (p=0.001) but confirmatory beyond-Markov claim remains unsupported without valid null control. The frozen FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING verdict is due to null methodology limitation, not absence of signal. C-WEB-DYNAMICS concerns real Web dynamics; all evidence remains synthetic SPA simulation.

product_action: NONE — No code changes, no product promotion. C-WEB-DYNAMICS remains HYPOTHESIS. No mechanism survives gate.
next_question: Is the 0.933-bit K2 PMI signal on the 12-state SPA primarily Markov (action determines next state given current state, requiring only current-state conditioning) or genuinely beyond-Markov (history K>2 adds predictive information beyond current state)? Compare state-history K2 PMI (0.933 bits) against action-history K3 PMI (1.221 bits) at N=5000 on the same SPA: if K3 >> K2, signal is primarily Markov; if K2 is comparable to or exceeds K3 after history conditioning, beyond-Markov structure is demonstrated. This decomposition does not require null centering (it is a ratio/comparison, not an absolute test) and resolves the interpretive ambiguity without resolving the null bias problem.
